name: hsrp-ops-platform
description: Real Mazon HSRP Operations — FastAPI backend + Vite frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && cd backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
